headline: H2FY27 Recovery in Sight

highlights: Higher fuel cost, with management projecting fuel cost to increase to INR 2.00/kcal in Q3FY27 (from INR 1.82 kcal in Q2FY27) and INR 2.15– 2.20/kcal in Q4FY27.
The management has moderated its FY30 capacity target to 25 MTPA (from 30 MTPA), indicating a slower pace of capacity expansion, which could moderate long-term volume growth potential.

We have lowered our FY27E EBITDA/t estimate to INR 652/t, factoring in elevated fuel cost, partly offset by improving realisation, higher renewable energy contribution and lower shutdown-related expense.

Despite near-term margin pressure, we remain constructive on JKLC's medium-term prospects, supported by (1) Improving pricing momentum, with management expecting further price increases of INR 10/bag in November and INR 10–15/bag in December, which should support realisation recovery; (2) Expected H2FY27 volume recovery of 7–8%; and (3) 4.6 MTPA capacity expansion across Durg, Madhubani and UCWL by March 2028.
valuation: We have revised our FY27E earnings estimate downward by 2.9% and cut our EV/CE multiple to 1.4x (from 1.6x earlier).
The management has moderated its FY30 capacity target to 25 MTPA (from 30 MTPA), indicating a slower pace of capacity expansion, which could moderate long-term volume growth potential.
We value JKLC using our EV/CE framework, assigning FY28E EV/CE multiple of 1.4x, arriving at a revised target price of INR 640/share.
